# StreamLoots sub-actions

## Send test event

Makes a pretend StreamLoots alert so you can try your actions without waiting for a real one.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Alert** | Which pretend alert to make: a purchase, a gift to one person, a gift to the community, or a card played. Options: purchase, gift, communityGift, redemption. Starts as: `redemption`. |

<small>Type id: `streamloots.sendTestEvent`</small>
